title: Style-Library Key→Var Mapping
description: Schema for the OODS Foundry-owned style-library mapping DATA artifact. Validated at load so a malformed library FAILS CLOSED instead of silently degrading to an empty map (which would V140 every measured colour key). It maps a logical style-library key — the FULL dotted leaf-path of a measured colour delta, e.g. 'color.surface.default' — to the target CSS custom-property on the --sys-/--ref- skin the consumer's measured colour should reach (padding already binds via the s121 tokenOverlay --oods- path; this is the colour-skin counterpart). Mirrors measure-registry.schema.json conventions: a DETERMINABLE ROOT TYPE (object, additionalProperties:false) so it survives Generator A's blind glob, and it is SKIP-LISTED from generated.ts (NON_SCHEMA_DATA_FILES in schemas-tools/generate-types.ts) so it never emits a type that collides with the hand-written StyleLibraryArtifact interface.

schemaVersion.description: Style-library artifact version (independent of the dashboard-spec schemaVersion).

mappings.description: Map of logical style-library key (the FULL dotted leaf-path of a measured colour delta, e.g. 'color.surface.default') to its target CSS custom-property name. The value is the trust boundary for the unescaped <style> sink, so it is constrained to the --sys-/--ref- skin namespace by pattern.
